text: انھے نوں ماں مسیتی سٹّ گئی۔
romanized: Annhe nūṅ māṅ masītī saṭṭ gaī.
literal_en: The mother has left her blind boy in the mosque.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses

meaning_pa: ماں انھے پتر نوں مسیتے سٹ گئی؛ یعنی اوس نوں بے آسرا چھڈ گئی۔
